'''"No Fatherland without you!"''' or '''"Song of the Eugenists!"''' is a [[People's Republic of Mariposia|Mariposian]] song a about ''[[Eugeniusz Bielszowicki]]'' and his supporters, composed by Bartosz Sikora and written by Zdzisław Mośko it extols his talents and achievements and beliefs of the Eugenist Goverment, and the Mariposian People's Loyalty to the state.

== Significance ==
'''"No Fatherland without you!"''' was composed especially for Eugeniusz and his supporters and it is considered their "signature song" being played during the [[1995 Mariposian Coup d'état]]. this song enjoy popularity in Mariposa, where it is played on the Mariposian People's National Television and is played each day and is also blasted on loudspeakers in the capital of [[Torzhes]].
